html:
The keys are due Friday, the truck is Thursday, and the oven still has last month's dinner baked into it. That is a very normal week for move out cleaning in 29651, the Greer ZIP code that stretches across the Greenville and Spartanburg county line. This article is built as a timeline, so you can see what to do in the last two days and where a professional crew fits in.

Why the last 48 hours matter in 29651

ZIP 29651 sits close to I-85, SC-14 and SC-101, which means a lot of people moving in and out of the area for work. Our team is based in Greer, so a ten minute drive covers most of this ZIP code. What we see over and over is that cleaning gets squeezed between the last box and the final walkthrough. A landlord or buyer looks at an empty house with the lights on, and an empty house shows everything.

If you want to see the full scope before reading on, the page for move-out cleaning in Greer lists what is covered room by room.

Two days out: empty what can be emptied

Cleaners cannot clean inside a cabinet that is still full. The best thing you can do two days ahead is clear the spaces that hide grime.

  • Pantry and kitchen cabinets: empty them completely, including the back corners.
  • Refrigerator and freezer: toss or move the food, and take out loose shelves if you can.
  • Closets: shelves, rods and floors need to be visible.
  • Garage or storage nooks that are part of the lease or sale.
  • Wall hangings, curtain rods and anything you plan to patch. Nail holes are a repair job, not a cleaning job.

One day out: the walkthrough and the crew

The day before handover is when a cleaning crew does its best work, because the furniture is gone and the floors are open. The order matters. We start high and finish low: ceiling fans, light fixtures and vents first, then walls and door frames, then cabinets, appliances and bathrooms, and floors last so nothing gets walked over after it is done.

AreaWhat gets attention
KitchenInside and outside of cabinets and drawers, oven, refrigerator, freezer, microwave, hood, stovetop and backsplash
BathroomsToilet base, grout, glass, vanity interiors, mirrors and fixtures
Bedrooms and closetsCloset shelves, rods and floors, baseboards, door frames, switch plates
WindowsSills, tracks and blinds
FloorsVacuumed and mopped edge to edge

The spots people forget are small ones: the track of a sliding door, the top of a door frame, the inside of the microwave vent, the bottom drawer under the oven. Those are the places a Brazilian detail-first method earns its name, because they are checked on purpose and not by luck.

How much does move out cleaning cost in Greer?

Perfect Services does not quote prices from a description or a photo. The exact price comes after a free in-home estimate, a quick visit where we look at the space with no commitment. What changes the number is mostly practical: the size of the home and the number of bedrooms and bathrooms, the condition the last occupant left it in, how much grease is on the oven and hood, whether the home is empty or still furnished, and how tight the timing is. A closing-day deadline can mean sending a larger team.

To set up the visit, use the form on the city page, call (864) 399-5168 or text (864) 666-8520. If you are still comparing options, the free estimate request takes about a minute.

How long it takes, and booking this week

An empty, lightly used apartment goes much faster than a four-bedroom house that was lived in for years. We can tell you more after the walkthrough. Because move-outs are tied to fixed dates, ask about booking this week as early as you can, and tell us the key date so we plan around it.

After handover: keep a record

Renters often want proof of a clean unit. Take date-stamped photos of the oven, bathrooms and closets after the crew leaves, and keep them with your lease paperwork. Landlords who turn over several rentals can read how another Upstate town handles it in this move-out checklist for renters, and homes in a neighboring community are covered on our end of lease cleaning in Taylors page.

If the home was also lived in with pets or after a long stay, a deep cleaning before the move-out visit can make the final pass quicker. Renters who plan to stay in the area may also want a recurring house cleaning plan once the new place is set up.

Questions we hear from 29651

Most calls start with one of three worries: will the deposit come back, will the oven pass, and can the date be met. The checklist above answers the first two. For the third, the team looks at the home first and then commits to a schedule, rather than promising a time on the phone.

What we usually see in a 29651 handover

A lot of move-outs we see in Greer follow the same pattern. The rooms people use daily, like the kitchen and main bathroom, get a quick wipe from the tenant, while the places nobody looks at all year stay untouched: the inside of the range hood, the shelf above the refrigerator, the bottom of the shower door track, the closet floor behind a shoe rack. Those are the items that turn a normal handover into a back-and-forth about the deposit, so we check them on purpose.

Homes near the older parts of Greer, closer to Downtown and Trade Street, often have more trim and more window sills, which adds detail work. Newer homes tend to have larger kitchens and pantries. Neither is harder, they simply take time in different rooms. That is also why we like to see the home before we commit to a schedule.

If you are a landlord or property manager turning over a rental, the same timeline works for you. Give the crew a day with the unit empty, share the move-out date with us, and ask for the walkthrough to happen before the new tenant is scheduled. It keeps the turnover from stacking up.

faqs: When should I schedule move out cleaning in 29651?
